title: Alert Evidence Envelope
user: On-call engineers and webhook consumers who need a safe, sufficient incident excerpt with an alert instead of a bare dashboard link followed by extra authenticated lookups.
smallest_useful_product: A webhook transformer that fetches a bounded configured query, redacts fields, attaches a signed evidence excerpt and query fingerprint, then forwards it to Slack/email/automation.
success_measure: For 20 seeded alerts, responders can identify service, error signature, and first-seen time without opening the source dashboard in at least 16 cases.
constraints: Strict per-channel redaction, size caps, short-lived upstream credentials, no raw payload retention by default; preserve alert-provider signatures where possible.
